card_description:
**Priority:** P0 | **Location:** Berlin/Los Angeles (Global) | **AUM:** $275M Fund 3 (2024)

**Investment Thesis:**
Global investment platform for gaming, AI, immersive media, and web3. Early- and mid-stage venture capital for 'extraordinary founders' across interactive entertainment. Built by gamers for gamers with explicit focus on infrastructure powering next-generation experiences.

**Why They're a Good Target:**
- Just raised $275M Fund 3 (June 2025) - fresh capital actively deploying
- Recent major investments: Appcharge ($58M Series B, Aug 2025), Power Protocol ($3M, Feb 2026)
- Portfolio includes Inworld AI (AI NPCs/characters) - showing active AI infrastructure thesis
- 3 unicorns in portfolio: Higgsfield (became unicorn 2025), Magic Eden, Immutable
- Moritz Baier-Lentz: ex-Goldman Sachs VP, co-head of gaming/esports investment banking ($300B+ transaction volume)
- Carlos Pereira: leads crypto/Web3 strategy with gaming/media background
- 130+ portfolio companies including Epic Games, Theorycraft Games, Anzu
- Global presence: Berlin, LA, SF, NYC, London, Singapore, Madrid, Barcelona, Chicago, Lisbon

**Key Partners:**

| Name | Title | Background | Priority |
|------|-------|------------|----------|
| Moritz Baier-Lentz | Partner | Ex-Goldman Sachs VP (Gaming/Esports M&A), Diablo II world champion | PRIMARY |
| Carlos Pereira | General Partner | Leads crypto/Web3 strategy, gaming/media investor | PRIMARY |
| Jens Hilgers | Founding General Partner | Co-founder ESL Gaming, gaming industry veteran | SECONDARY |
| Malte Barth | Founding General Partner | Operations and venture building background | SECONDARY |
| Scott Rupp | Founding General Partner | Entrepreneur and investor background | SECONDARY |

**Portfolio Companies (Recent):**
- Appcharge ($58M Series B, Aug 2025) - Direct-to-consumer gaming commerce platform
- Power Protocol ($3M, Feb 2026) - Blockchain game infrastructure platform
- Inworld AI - AI character engine for games (AI NPCs)
- Theorycraft Games - Game studio (ex-Riot/Blizzard/Bungie founders)
- Immutable - Blockchain gaming infrastructure (unicorn)
- Higgsfield AI - AI video generation (unicorn, 2025)
- Magic Eden - NFT marketplace (unicorn)

**Warm Path Opportunities:**
- Goldman Sachs network via Moritz Baier-Lentz (if IB background)
- Gaming/esports connections (ESL, Riot, Blizzard alumni)
- AI infrastructure founders (Inworld AI, Higgsfield connections)
- Berlin/LA gaming ecosystem connections
- Portfolio company intros (Theorycraft, Immutable, etc.)

**Recommended Outreach Angle:**
**Subject:** [Game Infrastructure/AI Tools] Seed - Powering Live Service Games

**Hook:** Lead with AI-augmented live service infrastructure. Reference Inworld AI investment as validation of AI thesis. Moritz's Goldman Sachs background means he appreciates scalable infrastructure and unit economics. Emphasize technical differentiation in crowded market.

**Key Talking Points:**
1. AI-powered live service game operations (analytics, moderation, player support)
2. Infrastructure play with clear developer value proposition
3. Global scaling from day one (aligns with Bitkraft's international presence)
4. Technical team with shipped games or platform experience
5. Path to becoming 'picks and shovels' for live service games

**Contact Information:**
- Moritz Baier-Lentz: moritz@bitkraft.vc | LinkedIn: /in/moritz-baier-lentz
- Carlos Pereira: carlos@bitkraft.vc | LinkedIn: /in/carlos-pereira-bitkraft
- Website: https://www.bitkraft.vc
- Fund: $275M Fund 3, actively deploying (2025)

**Research Sources:**
- https://www.bitkraft.vc/people
- https://www.bitkraft.vc/portfolio
- GamesBeat: Bitkraft raises $275M Fund 3 (June 2025)
- TechCrunch: Bitkraft gaming fund coverage
- Crunchbase: Bitkraft Ventures profile

**Next Action:** Send personalized cold email to Moritz Baier-Lentz emphasizing AI infrastructure and live service gaming thesis alignment.
